_comment: Read by the Android app to tell whether its NATIVE build is stale. Over-the-air JS updates are handled by expo-updates and need nothing here — bump `version` only when a new APK is genuinely required (a new permission, a native module change, or an Expo SDK upgrade). Served from the web app so it costs no backend and updates on every deploy.

android.notes: First release: automatic bank SMS capture with an offline retry queue.
